race.comment: ERIMAR (8) is the one to beat after putting a Class 1 away by three and a half lengths at Rockhampton as favourite, and his previous Open run at Doomben was also sound when beaten two and a half lengths behind High Prophet. He has won two of three at this distance and brings the strongest recent rating profile. WASABI BARBIE (9) is the clear danger, having resumed with an Open win at Rockhampton on soft ground and with a proven 1050m record. MISS MONEYPENNY (2) was below market expectations at Birdsville, but her Class 6 win at Cairns two back reads well for this and she handles wet ground. UNIFIES (1) is back from a six week freshen after a BM65 win at this track. In the mix.
